typesense:popular.greeting:
*In this story of a galaxy far, far away. You can be anything you want to!
You can be on the light side for the resistance, fighting the dark side. Or you can be on the dark side for the first order, fighting the light side.
And hell. You can be a robot for the separatists!
You can even be Jawa’s, Ewoks, togruta, zabraks, tusken raiders, rodians, twi’lek, abednedo, hutts, adarian, anomid, ardennian, bothan, chiss, falleen, sarlacc, sith purebloods, toydarian, wookiee and yuuzhan vong. 
Which they all speak there own special language (do some research if you want to be any of these)
And there are a lot of worlds like tatooine, coruscant, Alderaan, hoth, geonosis, Naboo, dagobah, polis massa, mustafar, kamino, kashyyyk, jakku, bespin, mandalore, corellia, ryloth, mon calamari, florrum, nal hutta, malachor V. (Also do research for these too)*

*Now have fun!*
 (Thanks for a million guys! Ima keep 69k here because haha funni number )
typesense:popular.name: Star Wars RP
typesense:popular.title: Be anything you want! A million?! Yippe! 🎉Damn💀 thanks a lot guys! 🗿
